title: UAE document preparation: start with the recipient
description: Confirm the format and official service before choosing a submission route.
answer: Get the UAE recipient’s instructions, identify the issuer and check the current official application service. The route can depend on the document and its origin.

sections.title: Define the purpose
sections.text: Employment, education, family and commercial requests may ask for different records. Identify the specific receiving organisation, not just the destination country.

sections.title: Check the format
sections.text: Ask whether the recipient needs an original, accepted digital document, certified copy or translation. Do not assume a scan has the same status as an original.

sections.title: Use the official service instructions
sections.text: The UAE official document service and relevant mission explain their current application channels. Follow the route assigned to your document and confirm availability for your case.

sections.title: Resolve inconsistencies first
sections.text: Compare names, dates and issuer details. Any correction should come through the responsible issuer; private assistance does not modify official records.

sections.title: Keep expectations clear
sections.text: Authentication does not itself promise employment, professional recognition or acceptance by every recipient. Confirm those requirements separately.

author: SK Attestation Services
